🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-23 23:00 → 2026-11-24 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **CPU proof run pushed deep into recursion** — the run reached roughly 1,870 core shards before its machine expired at midnight, leaving the end-to-end path only the proof artifact short. [tg:tawg:6522]

> **A proof-checking evaluator surfaced for agentic commerce** — an ERC-8183 follow-up reports that a working evaluator now exists with testing under way, giving agent work a concrete verification path. [ERC-8183 post #470](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/470)

> **A free ERC-8004 agent directory appeared** — a read-only listing of ERC-8004 agents on Ethereum mainnet gives builders a simple shared view of who is registered. [ERC-8004 post #457](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/457)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### proof pipeline

_The end-to-end path narrowed to a clear final step._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Reported** that the run sits essentially at the finish line, with the actual proof artifact the one remaining piece for a full end-to-end run, which shows precisely where the next effort goes. [tg:tawg:6528]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Volunteered** hands-on help right after the run's machine expired, keeping a stalled moment from becoming a dead end and making sure support is ready when the proving stage resumes. [tg:tawg:6527]

### parametric liquidity

_The modeling discussion moved into a clearer phase for group review._

- Alexander Zvezdin (@azvezdin) **Framed** the parametric liquidity model behind the team's price-prediction trading work, giving everyone a shared starting point for scrutiny and feedback. [tg:tawg:6524]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Line up compute with enough headroom for the proving stage, so the final artifact can land without another midnight cutoff.
- Give parametric liquidity a fuller write-up and invite the group to stress its assumptions before more code depends on it.
- Try the new proof-checking evaluator on a real submission to see how it handles messy agent work.

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Rerun the proving stage and close the end-to-end loop with the proof artifact in hand.
- Capture what the expired run already showed about shard throughput for the next attempt.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A proof run ran out of machine time, yet the team still closed the loop with a crisp next step and a ready hand for the resume.
>
> The last artifact is always the steepest stretch — keep the rope taut and the relay rolling, team 🧗
